traps.en: Writing $x\le-4$ means the inequality sign was flipped when it should not have been (dividing by a positive number).
traps.zh: 寫成 $x\le-4$ 表示不等號被誤轉向（除以正數時方向不變）。

tip.en: Solve each inequality separately, draw both on a number line, then take union for 'or' and intersection for 'and'.
tip.zh: 每條不等式分別解出，畫在同一條數線上：『or』取聯集、『and』取交集。

title.en: Step 1 · Total cost = total weight × unit cost
title.zh: 第 1 步 · 總成本＝總重量 × 每公斤成本

steps.en: The mixture costs 16 per kg and weighs $s+t$ kg, which must equal the sum of the two costs.
steps.zh: 混合物每公斤 16，共 $s+t$ 公斤，其總成本必等於兩種米的成本之和。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 化簡

steps.en: Expand the right side and collect: $18t-16t=16s-12s$.
steps.zh: 展開右邊再合併：$18t-16t=16s-12s$，得 $t=2s$。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: When $t=2s$, taking $s=1$ gives $t=2$ — option A. (Check: 12 + 36 = 48 for 3 kg, i.e. 16 per kg.)
steps.zh: 當 $t=2s$，取 $s=1$ 得 $t=2$，選 A。（驗算：1 公斤 S 與 2 公斤 T 共 12+36=48，除以 3 公斤正是 16。）

traps.en: 2:1 is the ratio $t:s$, not $s:t$ — check which quantity is asked first.
traps.zh: 2:1 是 $t:s$，不是題目問的 $s:t$ —— 要看清楚哪個量在前面。

traps.en: Averaging the two prices (12 and 18 and 16) without weighting gives the wrong split.
traps.zh: 把 12、18 與 16 直接取平均而沒有按重量加權，就會得到錯誤的比例。

tip.en: Mixture problems: write 'total cost = total weight × unit cost' as one equation, then the ratio follows from the simplified relation.
tip.zh: 混合問題：先把「總成本＝總重量 × 每單位成本」寫成一條方程，化簡後比例自然出現。

title.en: Step 1 · Quarterly rate and number of periods
title.zh: 第 1 步 · 每季利率與期數

steps.en: Compounded quarterly: the rate per period is 4%/4 = 1% and there are $5\times4=20$ periods.
steps.zh: 每季複利：每期利率為 4%/4 = 1%，期數為 $5\times4=20$。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 立式

steps.en: The amount after 20 periods at 1% per period is 80000.
steps.zh: 本金 $P$ 經 20 期、每期 1% 後為 80000。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: $1.01^{20}\approx1.22019$, so $P\approx65\,563.7$, i.e. 65 564 to the nearest integer — option B.

traps.en: Using 4% per year (once a year) instead of quarterly gives $80000/1.04^{5}\approx65\,754$.
Simple interest $80000/(1+4\%\times5)=66\,667$ ignores compounding altogether.

tip.en: 'Compounded quarterly' means divide the annual rate by 4 and multiply the years by 4 — fix both numbers before touching the calculator.
tip.zh: 「每季複利」＝年利率 ÷ 4、年數 × 4；先把這兩個數字定好再按計算機。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · $u$ 的新值

steps.en: $u$ increased by 44% means $u'=1.44u$; since $w$ varies as $\sqrt{u}$, take the square root: $1.44$ becomes $1.2$.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · $v$ 的新值

steps.en: $v$ decreased by 20% means $v'=0.8v$. Because $w$ varies inversely as $v$, this factor goes to the denominator.
steps.zh: $v$ 減少 20% 即 $v'=0.8v$；因 $w$ 與 $v$ 成反比，這個倍數放在分母。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: The new value is $1.5$ times the old, i.e. an increase of 50% — option B.
steps.zh: 新值是原值的 1.5 倍，即增加 50%，選 B。

traps.en: Forgetting the square root and using $1.44/0.8=1.8$ gives +80% — the $\sqrt{\ }$ must be applied first.
traps.zh: 忘記開方，直接用 $1.44/0.8=1.8$ 會得到 +80% —— 要先取平方根。

traps.en: Simply adding the two percentages (44% + 20% = 64%) ignores that one change is direct and the other is inverse.
traps.zh: 把兩個百分數直接相加（44% + 20% = 64%），忽略了兩者的正比／反比關係。

tip.en: For variation problems, convert each change into a multiplier: 'increased by 44%' → $1.44$, then apply the powers or roots required by the relation.
tip.zh: 變分題把每個變化寫成倍數（增加 44% → $1.44$），再按正比／反比關係取次方或根號。

title.en: Step 1 · Form of the general term
title.zh: 第 1 步 · 通項的形式

steps.en: The recurrence $a_{n+2}=3a_{n+1}-2a_{n}$ has auxiliary equation $r^{2}-3r+2=0$, so $a_{n}=A+B\cdot2^{n}$.

title.en: Step 2 · Use the two given terms
title.zh: 第 2 步 · 代入已知兩項

steps.en: Subtract the two equations: $28B=28$.

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: Substitute $n=8$ — option C.

traps.en: 131 is $a_{7}=3+128$ — the term number is off by one.
515 is $a_{9}=3+512$, i.e. one term too far (or $2^{8}$ counted as $2^{9}$).

tip.en: For $a_{n+2}=pa_{n+1}+qa_{n}$, solve the auxiliary equation $r^{2}=pr+q$ first; then the two given terms pin down the constants.
tip.zh: 遞推式形如 $a_{n+2}=pa_{n+1}+qa_{n}$，先解輔助方程 $r^{2}=pr+q$，再用已知兩項定出常數。

title.en: Step 1 · Use the common point on the positive $x$-axis
title.zh: 第 1 步 · 用正 x 軸上的交點

steps.en: Both lines pass through $(t,0)$ with $t>0$, so substituting $y=0$ gives $at=b$ and $ct=d$.
steps.zh: 兩線都過正 x 軸上的 $(t,0)$（$t>0$），代入 $y=0$ 得 $at=b$、$ct=d$。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 比較 $a$ 與 $c$

steps.en: The figure shows $b>d$, so dividing by the same positive $t$ gives $a>c$: statement I is false.
steps.zh: 由圖知 $b>d$，同除以正的 $t$ 得 $a>c$，故命題 I 錯誤。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: $b>d$ is true from the graph; and $ad=\frac{bd}{t}=bc$ makes III true. So II and III — option C.
steps.zh: 由圖得 $b>d$ 成立；又 $ad=\frac{bd}{t}=bc$，故 III 成立。答案是 II 與 III，選 C。

traps.en: Assuming a larger intercept means a larger $a$ — but $a=b/t$ and $c=d/t$ with the **same** $t$, so $b>d$ forces $a>c$.
traps.zh: 誤以為截距大斜率就大 —— 但 $a=b/t$、$c=d/t$ 用的是同一個 $t$，所以 $b>d$ 會迫使 $a>c$。

traps.en: Stopping after I and II without testing the algebraic relation in III.
traps.zh: 做完 I、II 就停手，沒有檢驗 III 的代數關係。

tip.en: When two lines meet on the $x$-axis, put $y=0$ and write each coefficient as (intercept)/(x-coordinate) — then the comparison is immediate.
tip.zh: 兩線交於 x 軸時，代 $y=0$，把係數寫成（截距）÷（交點橫坐標），大小比較就一目了然。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 展開看首項

steps.en: The coefficient of $x^{2}$ is $pq$, which is negative, so the graph opens downwards: statement I is true.
steps.zh: $x^{2}$ 的係數是 $pq$，因 $pq<0$ 為負，圖像開口向下，命題 I 成立。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 數 x 截距

steps.en: $pq<0$ means $p$ and $q$ have opposite signs, so the two roots can never be equal — there are two $x$-intercepts: II is true.
steps.zh: $pq<0$ 表示 $p$ 與 $q$ 異號，兩個根不可能相等，故有兩個 x 截距，命題 II 成立。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: At $x=0$ the value is 2, not 0, so the graph does not pass through the origin: III is false. Answer A.
steps.zh: 當 $x=0$，$y=2\neq0$，圖像不經原點，命題 III 錯誤。答案 A。

traps.en: Seeing two brackets and assuming $x=0$ is a root — substitute $x=0$ to check: $y=(0+1)(0+2)=2$.
traps.zh: 看到兩個括號就以為 $x=0$ 是根 —— 代入 $x=0$ 檢查：$y=(0+1)(0+2)=2$。

traps.en: Forgetting that the sign of $pq$ decides the opening direction, so the graph actually opens downwards.
traps.zh: 忘記 $pq$ 的正負決定開口方向，實際上此圖像開口向下。

tip.en: For $y=(px+1)(qx+2)$: the sign of $pq$ tells you the opening direction, the two brackets give the roots, and $x=0$ gives the $y$-intercept.
tip.zh: 對 $y=(px+1)(qx+2)$：$pq$ 的正負看開口方向、兩個括號給根、代 $x=0$ 得 y 截距。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 扇形周長

steps.en: A sector is bounded by two radii and the arc, so its perimeter is $2r+s$ with $r=14$.
steps.zh: 扇形由兩條半徑與弧圍成，周長是 $2r+s$，其中 $r=14$。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 扇形面積

steps.en: The area $\frac12rs$ equals $3k$, and $r=14$ gives $\frac12(14)s=7s$.
steps.zh: 面積 $\frac12rs$ 等於 $3k$，代入 $r=14$ 得 $7s=3k$。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: Eliminate $k$: substitute $k=28+s$. The arc length is 21 cm — option B.
steps.zh: 把 $k=28+s$ 代入消去 $k$，得 $4s=84$，弧長 21 cm，選 B。

traps.en: 28 is $2r$, the two radii — that is the straight part of the perimeter, not the arc.
traps.zh: 28 是 $2r$（兩條半徑），那是周長中的直線部分，不是弧長。

traps.en: Writing the area condition as $rs=3k$ (dropping the $\frac12$) overstates the arc length.
traps.zh: 把面積條件寫成 $rs=3k$（漏了 $\frac12$）會高估弧長。

tip.en: Sector formulas: perimeter $=2r+s$, area $=\frac12rs=\frac{\theta}{360}\pi r^{2}$ — write them down before substituting, and never forget the two radii.
tip.zh: 扇形公式：周長 $=2r+s$、面積 $=\frac12rs=\frac{\theta}{360}\pi r^{2}$；代入前先寫好，千萬別漏掉兩條半徑。

title.en: Step 1 · Volume of the whole pyramid
title.zh: 第 1 步 · 整個金字塔體積

steps.en: Base area $18\times16$ times height 12, divided by 3.
steps.zh: 底面積 $18\times16$ 乘高 12 再除以 3。

title.en: Step 2 · Volume of the small pyramid $X$
title.zh: 第 2 步 · 小金字塔 $X$ 的體積

steps.en: The cutting plane is parallel to the base, so $X$ is similar to the whole pyramid with length ratio $12/16=3/4$; volumes go as the cube of the ratio.
steps.zh: 截面平行於底面，故 $X$ 與整個金字塔相似，長度比為 $12/16=3/4$；體積按比的三次方縮放。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: The frustum is what remains after removing $X$ — option B.
steps.zh: 台體是扣掉 $X$ 之後剩下的部分，得 666，選 B。

traps.en: 486 is the volume of the small pyramid $X$; the question asks for the frustum $Y$.
traps.zh: 486 是小金字塔 $X$ 的體積，題目問的是台體 $Y$。

traps.en: Using the length ratio or the area ratio instead of the cube of the ratio for a volume.
traps.zh: 算體積時誤用長度比（或面積比），體積要用相似比的三次方。

tip.en: Similar solids: lengths scale as $k$, areas as $k^{2}$, volumes as $k^{3}$; a frustum is always 'whole minus the removed similar piece'.
tip.zh: 相似立體：長度比 $k$、面積比 $k^{2}$、體積比 $k^{3}$；台體＝整體減去被切走的相似部分。

title.en: Step 1 · Find the height from the area of $\Delta ABD$
title.zh: 第 1 步 · 由 $\Delta ABD$ 的面積求高

steps.en: Take $AB=3$ units and $CD=5$ units (the ratio $3:5$). With base $AB$, the area gives the height between the parallel sides.
steps.zh: 取 $AB=3$ 單位、$CD=5$ 單位（即比 $3:5$）。以 $AB$ 為底，由面積可求兩平行線間的高。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 上方小梯形

steps.en: $E$ divides $BD$ in $2:3$, so $BE:BD=2:5$. As $EF\parallel AB$ and $BF\parallel AD$, the top piece is a scaled copy at ratio $2/5$: both its parallel side and its height scale by $2/5$.
steps.zh: $E$ 把 $BD$ 分成 $2:3$，故 $BE:BD=2:5$。因 $EF\parallel AB$、$BF\parallel AD$，上方部分是比例 $2/5$ 的相似圖形：平行邊與高都乘 $2/5$。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: Trapezium area $=\frac12(CD+EF)\times$ height difference $=279$ cm² — option C.
steps.zh: 梯形面積 $=\frac12(CD+EF)\times$ 高差 $=279$ cm²，選 C。

traps.en: Scaling only one of EF and the height by $2/5$ (they scale together, since the top piece is similar).
traps.zh: 只把 $EF$ 或高其中一項乘 $2/5$ —— 兩者要一起縮放（上方部分與原圖相似）。

traps.en: Using the full height 150 for the trapezium instead of the gap $150-60=90$.
traps.zh: 用整條高 150 算梯形，而沒有用 $150-60=90$ 這個高差。

tip.en: In parallel-line figures, a line parallel to the base cuts a similar figure; convert the given ratio into a scale factor and apply it to every length.
tip.zh: 平行線圖形中，與底平行的線會切出相似圖形；把已知比化成比例因子，所有長度（含高）一起乘。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 認出斜邊

steps.en: The right angle is at $P$, so the side opposite it, $QR=p$, is the hypotenuse; $PR=q$ is a leg.
steps.zh: 直角在 $P$，故對邊 $QR=p$ 是斜邊，$PR=q$ 是其中一條直角邊。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 用 $\theta$ 表示 $PQ$

steps.en: In the right angle at $Q$, $PQ$ is the side adjacent to $\theta$ and $QR$ is the hypotenuse.
steps.zh: 在 $Q$ 的直角關係中，$PQ$ 是 $\theta$ 的鄰邊、$QR$ 是斜邊。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: The two legs of the right angle at $P$ are $PQ$ and $PR$ — option C.
steps.zh: $P$ 處的兩條直角邊是 $PQ$ 與 $PR$，面積 $\frac12 pq\cos\theta$，選 C。

traps.en: Using $\sin$ means $PQ$ was taken as the opposite side of $\theta$ — but the opposite side of $\theta$ is $PR=q$.
traps.zh: 用 $\sin$ 等於把 $PQ$ 當成 $\theta$ 的對邊 —— 但 $\theta$ 的對邊是 $PR=q$。

traps.en: The area is a product of two lengths, so only $\sin$ or $\cos$ can appear; $\tan$ would give a ratio, not an area.
traps.zh: 面積是兩個長度相乘，只會出現 $\sin$ 或 $\cos$；$\tan$ 得出的是比值，不是面積。

tip.en: For a right triangle write down 'which angle, which side': adjacent/hypotenuse → $\cos$, opposite/hypotenuse → $\sin$; then substitute into $\frac12\times$ base $\times$ height.
tip.zh: 直角三角形先寫清楚「哪個角、哪條邊」：鄰邊／斜邊用 $\cos$，對邊／斜邊用 $\sin$；再代入 $\frac12\times$ 底 $\times$ 高。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 在 $\Delta DCE$ 求 $DE$

steps.en: Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal, so $DC=3$; the right angle at $C$ gives the 3-4-5 triangle.
steps.zh: 長方形對邊相等，故 $DC=3$；$C$ 是直角，得 3-4-5 直角三角形。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 相似三角形

steps.en: $FB\parallel DC$ (both along $AB$/$DC$) and $FE$ is the same line as $DE$, so the two triangles are similar; the ratio of corresponding sides is $BE:CE$.
steps.zh: $FB\parallel DC$（同在 $AB$／$DC$ 方向）且 $FE$ 與 $DE$ 同線，故兩三角形相似；對應邊比為 $BE:CE$。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: So $EF$ is three times $DE$ — option B.
steps.zh: 故 $EF$ 是 $DE$ 的三倍，得 15，選 B。

traps.en: 16 is $BC=BE+CE$ — that is the side of the rectangle, not $EF$.
traps.zh: 16 是 $BC=BE+CE$（長方形的邊），不是 $EF$。

traps.en: 13 comes from using the wrong pair of corresponding sides (e.g. adding the height $DC$ to $BE-CE$).
traps.zh: 13 來自用錯對應邊（例如把高 $DC$ 誤加在 $BE-CE$ 上）。

tip.en: When two lines are produced to meet, look for similar triangles first; match the vertices by the parallel lines, then use the ratio of the known collinear segments.
tip.zh: 題目把線延長交於一點時，先找相似三角形：用平行線配對頂點，再用共線段的比例求長。

title.en: Step 1 · Is there a right angle?
title.zh: 第 1 步 · 有沒有直角？

steps.en: $WX=9$, $WY=40$, $XY=41$ satisfy Pythagoras, so $\angle XWY=90^{\circ}$.
steps.zh: $WX=9$、$WY=40$、$XY=41$ 符合畢氏定理，故 $\angle XWY=90^{\circ}$。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 相似三角形

steps.math: \angle WXY=\angle YWZ,\ \angle WYX=\angle WZY \Rightarrow \Delta WXY\sim\Delta WZY
steps.en: Two pairs of equal angles give the similarity; the correspondence is $X\leftrightarrow W$, $Y\leftrightarrow Z$, $W\leftrightarrow Y$.
steps.zh: 兩對角相等即相似；對應關係是 $X\leftrightarrow W$、$Y\leftrightarrow Z$、$W\leftrightarrow Y$。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: Sides in the ratio $40:9$; perimeter $=9+41+\frac{1600}{9}+\frac{1640}{9}=50+360=410$ cm — option C.

traps.en: 100 treats the quadrilateral as if $WZ=XY$ and $ZY=WX$ (i.e. a parallelogram) — the correct sides come from the similarity ratio $40:9$.
traps.zh: 100 等於把四邊形當成平行四邊形（$WZ=XY$、$ZY=WX$）—— 正確的是用相似比 $40:9$ 求邊。

traps.en: Using the ratio $\frac{WX}{WY}=\frac{9}{40}$ the wrong way round shrinks the sides instead of enlarging them.
traps.zh: 把比例 $\frac{WX}{WY}=\frac{9}{40}$ 用反了，會把邊縮小而不是放大。

tip.en: Match similar-triangle vertices by the equal angles first, then every side ratio follows; when the perimeter is a neat number, expect fractions along the way.
tip.zh: 相似三角形先用等角配對頂點，之後所有邊比自然出現；周長是整數時，中途分數通常會互相抵消。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · $BCEF$ 是長方形

steps.en: In a regular hexagon opposite sides are parallel and equal, so $BC\parallel EF$ and $BC=EF$; hence $BCEF$ is a parallelogram, giving $BF\parallel CE$ (and $BC\perp BF$). Since $G$ lies on $BF$, $BG\parallel CE$: statement I is true.
steps.zh: 正六邊形對邊平行且相等，故 $BC\parallel EF$、$BC=EF$，$BCEF$ 為平行四邊形，得 $BF\parallel CE$（且 $BC\perp BF$）。$G$ 在 $BF$ 上，故 $BG\parallel CE$，命題 I 成立。

title.en: Step 2 · Compare the sides of the two triangles
title.zh: 第 2 步 · 比較兩三角形的邊

steps.en: $\Delta ABF$ has $AB=AF=1$, $BF=\sqrt3$ (since $\angle BAF=120^{\circ}$), so $\angle ABF=30^{\circ}$; with $\angle ABC=120^{\circ}$ we get $\angle CBF=90^{\circ}$. In the 30-60-90 triangle $BCG$ ($BC=1$), $BG=\frac{1}{\sqrt3}$ and $CG=\frac{2}{\sqrt3}$, so $AG=AC-CG=\sqrt3-\frac{2}{\sqrt3}=\frac{1}{\sqrt3}$. Thus $\Delta ABG$ has sides $1:\frac{1}{\sqrt3}:\frac{1}{\sqrt3}$, and $\Delta BDC$ has $BD=\sqrt3$, $DC=BC=1$, i.e. the same ratio: statement II is true.
steps.zh: $\Delta ABF$ 中 $AB=AF=1$、$BF=\sqrt3$（因 $\angle BAF=120^{\circ}$），故 $\angle ABF=30^{\circ}$；配合 $\angle ABC=120^{\circ}$ 得 $\angle CBF=90^{\circ}$。在 30-60-90 的 $\Delta BCG$（$BC=1$）中，$BG=\frac{1}{\sqrt3}$、$CG=\frac{2}{\sqrt3}$，故 $AG=AC-CG=\sqrt3-\frac{2}{\sqrt3}=\frac{1}{\sqrt3}$。於是 $\Delta ABG$ 三邊比為 $1:\frac{1}{\sqrt3}:\frac{1}{\sqrt3}$，而 $\Delta BDC$ 的 $BD=\sqrt3$、$DC=BC=1$ 比值相同，命題 II 成立。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: From Step 2, $GF=BF-BG=\sqrt3-\frac{\sqrt3}{3}=\frac{2\sqrt3}{3}=GC$, and $AF=BC$; with $AG=BG$ the two triangles are congruent (SSS): statement III is true. All three hold — option D.
steps.zh: 由第 2 步，$GF=BF-BG=\sqrt3-\frac{\sqrt3}{3}=\frac{2\sqrt3}{3}=GC$，且 $AF=BC$；配合 $AG=BG$，兩三角形 SSS 全等，命題 III 成立。三個都對，選 D。

traps.en: Judging from the picture that $BG$ and $CE$ are not parallel — but $BCEF$ is a parallelogram, so they are.
traps.zh: 憑圖覺得 $BG$ 與 $CE$ 不平行 —— 但 $BCEF$ 是平行四邊形，它們確實平行。

traps.en: Comparing the wrong pairs of sides in II (e.g. $AB$ with $BC$) makes the ratio look unequal.
traps.zh: 比較 II 時配錯對應邊（例如把 $AB$ 對上 $BC$），比例就會看起來不相等。

tip.en: In a regular hexagon, remember $\angle ABC=120^{\circ}$, opposite sides parallel and equal, and the two-step diagonal $=\sqrt3\times$ side; these three facts settle most such questions.
tip.zh: 正六邊形記住三件事：內角 $120^{\circ}$、對邊平行且相等、跨兩邊的對角線 $=\sqrt3\times$ 邊長；多數題目用這三點就解得完。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 平移

steps.en: 'Leftwards by 5 units' subtracts 5 from the $x$-coordinate only.
steps.zh: 「向左移 5 單位」只把 $x$ 坐標減 5。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 逆時針旋轉 $270^{\circ}$

steps.en: Anticlockwise $270^{\circ}$ = clockwise $90^{\circ}$, and a clockwise quarter turn sends $(x,y)$ to $(y,-x)$.
steps.zh: 逆時針 $270^{\circ}$ 等於順時針 $90^{\circ}$；順時針轉 90° 把 $(x,y)$ 變成 $(y,-x)$。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: Applying it to $U(-2,1)$ gives $(1,2)$ — option D.

traps.en: Rotating only $90^{\circ}$ anticlockwise (rule $(x,y)\mapsto(-y,x)$) gives $y=-2$.
traps.zh: 只轉 $90^{\circ}$（規則 $(x,y)\mapsto(-y,x)$）會得到 y 坐標 $-2$。

traps.en: Rotating $180^{\circ}$ instead of $270^{\circ}$ gives $y=-1$.
traps.zh: 轉 $180^{\circ}$ 而不是 $270^{\circ}$，會得到 y 坐標 $-1$。

tip.en: Memorise the quarter turns: anticlockwise $90^{\circ}$ $(x,y)\to(-y,x)$ and clockwise $90^{\circ}$ $(x,y)\to(y,-x)$; any multiple of $90^{\circ}$ follows from these.
tip.zh: 記住 90° 旋轉：逆時針 $(x,y)\to(-y,x)$、順時針 $(x,y)\to(y,-x)$，其他 $90^{\circ}$ 倍數都可由此推出。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 圓心角

steps.en: $T$ lies on $OQ$, so $OP$ and $OT$ make the same angle as $OP$ and $OQ$.
steps.zh: $T$ 在 $OQ$ 上，故 $OP$ 與 $OT$ 的夾角就是 $OP$ 與 $OQ$ 的夾角。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · $\Delta POT$ 的內角

steps.en: $TO$ and $TQ$ are opposite rays, so $\angle PTO$ is supplementary to $\angle PTQ=104^{\circ}$; the angle sum then gives $\angle OPT=22^{\circ}$.
steps.zh: $TO$ 與 $TQ$ 反向，故 $\angle PTO$ 與 $\angle PTQ=104^{\circ}$ 互補；再由內角和得 $\angle OPT=22^{\circ}$。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: In isosceles $\Delta OPR$ ($OP=OR$ as radii), $\angle ORP=\angle OPR=22^{\circ}$. Hence $\angle QOR=136^{\circ}-82^{\circ}=54^{\circ}$, and the angle in the alternate segment gives $\angle QSR=\frac{54^{\circ}}{2}=27^{\circ}$ — option B.
steps.zh: 等腰 $\Delta OPR$（$OP=OR$ 為半徑）中 $\angle ORP=\angle OPR=22^{\circ}$，故 $\angle QOR=136^{\circ}-82^{\circ}=54^{\circ}$；由同弓形圓周角得 $\angle QSR=\frac{54^{\circ}}{2}=27^{\circ}$，選 B。

traps.en: 22° is the angle at $P$ in $\Delta POT$, not the inscribed angle asked for — one more step ($\angle QOR\div2$) is needed.
traps.zh: 22° 是 $\Delta POT$ 在 $P$ 的角，不是題目要的圓周角 —— 還要再算 $\angle QOR\div2$。

traps.en: Halving the wrong central angle (or using $136^{\circ}$) gives a value near 49°; the inscribed angle must subtend $\angle QOR$.
traps.zh: 把錯誤的圓心角除以 2（或用 $136^{\circ}$）會得到接近 49° 的值；圓周角要對應 $\angle QOR$。

tip.en: When a diameter-like radius meets a chord inside the circle, first find the triangle's angles at the centre, then use 'angle at centre $=2\times$ angle at circumference'.
tip.zh: 半徑與弦在圓內相交時，先求出圓心處的三角形內角，再用「圓心角＝圓周角的兩倍」。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 認出軌跡

steps.en: The set of points equidistant from two straight lines is the pair of angle bisectors of the lines.
steps.zh: 與兩條直線距離相等的點集，就是這兩條直線的兩條角平分線。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 兩線是否相交

steps.en: The slopes $-\frac35$ and $\frac{3}{5}$ are different, so $L_1$ and $L_2$ are not parallel; they cross, giving two distinct bisectors.
steps.zh: 斜率 $-\frac35$ 與 $\frac{3}{5}$ 不同，$L_1$ 與 $L_2$ 不平行而相交，故有兩條不同的角平分線。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: The locus is two straight lines — option D.
steps.zh: 軌跡是一對直線，選 D。

traps.en: A single point would mean only one point is equidistant — no: every point on either bisector is.
traps.zh: 「一點」意味只有一個點等距 —— 其實兩條角平分線上的每一點都等距。

traps.en: A circle is the locus of points at a fixed distance from ONE point, not from two lines.
traps.zh: 圓是「與某一點距離固定」的軌跡，不是與兩條直線等距。

tip.en: Locus language: equidistant from two points → perpendicular bisector; from two lines → angle bisectors; from one point → circle.
tip.zh: 軌跡語言：與兩點等距 → 垂直平分線；與兩直線等距 → 角平分線；與一點等距 → 圓。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 設圓心

steps.en: The centre has $x$-coordinate 5; its $y$-coordinate is unknown.
steps.zh: 圓心的 $x$ 坐標是 5，$y$ 坐標未知。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 半徑相等

steps.en: The distances to $(5,0)$ and $(11,4)$ are both radii, so equate them.
steps.zh: 到 $(5,0)$ 與 $(11,4)$ 的距離都是半徑，令兩者相等。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: The circumference is $13\pi$ — option A.
steps.zh: 周長 $=2\pi r=13\pi$，選 A。

traps.en: 22π uses $r=11$, taking the $x$-coordinate of $(11,4)$ as the radius — the radius is a distance, not a coordinate.
traps.zh: 22π 用了 $r=11$，把 $(11,4)$ 的 $x$ 坐標當半徑 —— 半徑是距離，不是坐標。

traps.en: 42π is about a diameter of 42; it comes from confusing diameter with radius.
traps.zh: 42π 相當於直徑 42，是把直徑與半徑混淆。

tip.en: For a circle through two points with a known centre line, just use 'radius = radius': set the two distance expressions equal and solve.
tip.zh: 已知圓心在某直線上、圓過兩點時，直接用「半徑＝半徑」：令兩個距離式相等後解方程。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 配對總數

steps.en: Two cards are drawn at the same time, so order does not matter: 10 equally likely pairs.
steps.zh: 同時抽兩張，次序不重要，共有 $\binom52=10$ 個等可能的組合。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 數有利組合

steps.en: Only sums greater than 7 count: $2+6=8$ (two ways, since there are two 2's), $3+6=9$, $4+6=10$.

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: Simplify the fraction — option C.
steps.zh: 約簡後得 $\frac25$，選 C。

traps.en: $\frac{3}{10}$ counts only one of the two $(2,6)$ pairs — the two cards numbered 2 are distinct cards.
traps.zh: $\frac{3}{10}$ 只算了一個 $(2,6)$ 組合 —— 兩張寫著 2 的是不同的紙卡。

traps.en: $\frac15$ is $\frac{2}{10}$, counting only the $(2,6)$ pairs and forgetting $3+6$ and $4+6$.

tip.en: List every pair systematically (fix the smaller card and pair it with each larger one); identical numbers are still separate cards, so count them separately.
tip.zh: 系統地列出所有組合（固定較小的那張，逐個配對），數字相同但卡片不同，要分別計算。

title.en: Step 1 · What a box-and-whisker diagram shows
title.zh: 第 1 步 · 盒鬚圖顯示甚麼

steps.en: The five marks on a box-and-whisker diagram are exactly these five values.
steps.zh: 盒鬚圖上的五個記號正正就是這五個值。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 哪些命題可以得出

steps.en: The lower quartile is read off directly (II), and the inter-quartile range is $Q_3-Q_1$ (III). The mean needs every individual datum, which the diagram does not show (I is false).
steps.zh: 下四分位數可直接讀出（II）；四分位距為 $Q_3-Q_1$（III）。平均數需要每一個數據，圖中沒有（I 錯）。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: So II and III — option D.
steps.zh: 故 II 與 III，選 D。

traps.en: Reading the median as if it were the mean — they are equal only for symmetric data, and the diagram alone cannot tell.
traps.zh: 把中位數當成平均數 —— 只有對稱數據才會相等，單憑盒鬚圖無法判斷。

traps.en: Assuming the median mark is the mean.
traps.zh: 誤以為圖上的中位數就是平均數。

tip.en: Box-and-whisker gives position (quartiles, median, range, IQR) but never the sum of the data, so the mean and standard deviation cannot be read off.
tip.zh: 盒鬚圖只給位置資訊（四分位數、中位數、全距、四分位距），沒有數據總和，所以平均數與標準差都讀不出來。

title.en: Step 1 · Use the mean and the range
title.zh: 第 1 步 · 用平均數與全距

steps.en: The ten numbers have mean 9, so their sum is 90; the known ones add up to 68. The range is already $13-4=9$, so neither $x$ nor $y$ can lie outside $[4,13]$. Hence $x,y\ge9$.
steps.zh: 十個數平均 9，總和 90，已知數之和為 68。全距已是 $13-4=9$，故 $x,y$ 都不能超出 $[4,13]$，於是 $x,y\ge9$。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 中位數

steps.en: In order, the data are $4,7,7,7,8,\min(x,y),\ldots$, so the 5th value is 8 and the 6th is at least 9: statement II is always true.
steps.zh: 由小至大排列為 $4,7,7,7,8,\min(x,y),\ldots$，第 5 個是 8、第 6 個至少是 9，故命題 II 恆成立。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: But $x=y=11$ is allowed, and then the variance is $70\div10=7$ (so I fails) and the mode is 11 (so III fails). Only II must be true — option B.
steps.zh: 但 $x=y=11$ 也符合條件，此時變異數為 $70\div10=7$（I 不成立）、眾數為 11（III 不成立）。只有 II 必然成立，選 B。

traps.en: Testing only one pair (say $x=9,y=13$) makes III look true; $x=y=11$ is a counter-example.
traps.zh: 只試一組（例如 $x=9,y=13$）會覺得 III 成立；$x=y=11$ 就是反例。

traps.en: Statement I fails too: with $x=y=11$ the variance is exactly 7, and with other pairs it is larger than 7.
traps.zh: 命題 I 也不成立：$x=y=11$ 時變異數正好是 7，其他情況更超過 7。

tip.en: For 'must be true' questions, find the complete range of the unknowns first, then look for a counter-example — one valid set that breaks a statement is enough.
tip.zh: 「必然成立」的題目：先定出未知數的完整範圍，再找反例 —— 只要有一組合法數據推翻命題，該命題就不成立。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 分成兩段

steps.en: Sixteen binary digits: read the top eight bits and the bottom eight bits separately.
steps.zh: 十六個二進位數字：高位八位與低位八位分開看。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 各段的值
答案

steps.en: The high byte stands for $2^{8}$ times its value — option A.
steps.zh: 高位元組代表它本身的值乘 $2^{8}$，得 $21\times2^{11}+14$，選 A。

traps.en: $+28$ doubles the low byte: the last four bits $1110$ are $8+4+2=14$, not 28.
Using $2^{12}$ means one bit was skipped — the high byte covers $2^{15}$ down to $2^{8}$.

tip.en: For a long binary string, split it into bytes (or nibbles): the high part contributes its value times $2^{8}$ (or $2^{4}$).
tip.zh: 長二進位數先按位元組（或半位元組）切開：高位部分代表「它的值 × $2^{8}$（或 $2^{4}$）」。

title.en: Step 1 · The rule for each letter
title.zh: 第 1 步 · 每個字母的規則

steps.en: For every variable, the smallest exponent among the three expressions is the H.C.F. exponent and the largest is the L.C.M. exponent.
steps.zh: 對每個字母而言，三個指數中最小的等於 H.C.F. 的指數、最大的等於 L.C.M. 的指數。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 定 $x$ 與 $y$

steps.en: $x$: the first two have $x^{1}$, so the third must carry $x^{2}$ to reach the L.C.M. $x^{2}$. $y$: to make the maximum 4 the third must be $y^{4}$.
steps.zh: $x$：前兩式都是 $x^{1}$，故第三式需帶 $x^{2}$ 才達到 L.C.M. 的 $x^{2}$。$y$：要令最大為 4，第三式須為 $y^{4}$。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: $z$: the minimum of $6,4$ and the unknown is 3, so the third expression carries $z^{3}$ (and indeed $\max(6,4,3)=6$ matches the L.C.M.). The third expression is $x^{2}y^{4}z^{3}$ — option D.
steps.zh: $z$：$6$、$4$ 與未知數的最小值是 3，故第三式帶 $z^{3}$（而 $\max(6,4,3)=6$ 正好符合 L.C.M.）。第三式為 $x^{2}y^{4}z^{3}$，選 D。

traps.en: Taking $y^{4}$ but keeping $z^{4}$: the H.C.F. has $z^{3}$, so the smallest of $6,4$ and the third exponent must be 3.
traps.zh: 取了 $y^{4}$ 卻保留 $z^{4}$：H.C.F. 是 $z^{3}$，所以 $6$、$4$ 與第三個指數中的最小值必須是 3。

traps.en: $y^{2}$ leaves the maximum at 3 ($xy^{3}z^{6}$ already reaches $y^{3}$), so the L.C.M. could never be $y^{4}$.
traps.zh: $y^{2}$ 會令最大值停留在 3（$xy^{3}z^{6}$ 本身已達 $y^{3}$），L.C.M. 就永遠到不了 $y^{4}$。

tip.en: For H.C.F./L.C.M. of expressions, compare exponents variable by variable: min must equal the H.C.F. and max must equal the L.C.M.
tip.zh: 求多項式的 H.C.F./L.C.M.：逐個字母比較指數，最小值要等於 H.C.F.、最大值要等於 L.C.M.。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 首兩項

steps.en: The first term is $S_1$; the second is $S_2-S_1$. So the 2nd term is 6, not 8 — statement I is false.
steps.zh: 首項為 $S_1$；第二項為 $S_2-S_1$。故第 2 項是 6 而不是 8，命題 I 錯誤。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 通項

steps.en: This holds for $n\ge2$ (and also for $n=1$: $2\cdot3^{0}=2$). Each term is the previous one times 3, so the sequence is geometric — statement II is true.
steps.zh: 此式對 $n\ge2$ 成立（$n=1$ 亦合：$2\cdot3^{0}=2$）。每項是前一項的 3 倍，故為等比數列，命題 II 成立。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: $3^{n-1}$ is an integer, so every term is a multiple of 2 — statement III is true. Answer: II and III, option C.
steps.zh: $3^{n-1}$ 是整數，故每項都是 2 的倍數，命題 III 成立。答案為 II 與 III，選 C。

traps.en: Taking $a_2=S_2=8$ — but $S_2$ is the sum of the first two terms, not the second term.
traps.zh: 把 $a_2$ 當成 $S_2=8$ —— 但 $S_2$ 是首兩項之和，不是第二項。

traps.en: Accepting I and II but forgetting to check the parity in III.
traps.zh: 接受了 I 與 II，卻忘了檢驗 III 的奇偶性。

tip.en: Always use $a_n=S_n-S_{n-1}$ (for $n\ge2$) and check $a_1=S_1$ separately; never read $a_n$ straight off $S_n$.
tip.zh: 一律用 $a_n=S_n-S_{n-1}$（$n\ge2$），再單獨檢查 $a_1=S_1$；不要把 $S_n$ 直接當成 $a_n$。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 化簡分子
第 2 步 · 令整式為實數

steps.en: Multiply by the conjugate of the denominator; the denominator becomes the real number $\beta^{2}+1$.
steps.zh: 分子分母同乘分母的共軛，分母化為實數 $\beta^{2}+1$。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: For a real value the imaginary part must vanish — option C.
steps.zh: 要是實數，虛部必須為 0，故 $\beta=1$，選 C。

traps.en: Getting $-2$ usually means a sign slip in $i^{3}=-i$ or in the conjugate step.
traps.zh: 得到 $-2$ 通常是 $i^{3}=-i$ 或共軛那一步的符號出錯。

traps.en: Setting the real part to 0 instead of the imaginary part gives $\beta=-1$; a real number needs **zero imaginary part**.
traps.zh: 令實部為 0（而不是虛部）會得到 $\beta=-1$；要成為實數，需要**虛部為 0**。

tip.en: To make $\frac{z}{w}$ real, multiply by the conjugate of $w$ and set the imaginary part of the product to zero — $z\bar w$ must be real.
tip.zh: 要令 $\frac{z}{w}$ 為實數：乘以 $w$ 的共軛後，令乘積的虛部為 0 —— 即 $z\bar w$ 要是實數。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 增函數還是減函數？

steps.en: As $x$ increases, $\log_3(x+4)$ increases, so $2-\log_3(x+4)$ **decreases**. Statement I is false.
steps.zh: 當 $x$ 增大，$\log_3(x+4)$ 增大，故 $2-\log_3(x+4)$ **減少**。命題 I 錯誤。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · x 截距

steps.en: So the $x$-intercept is $x=5$ — statement II is true.
steps.zh: 故 x 截距為 $x=5$，命題 II 成立。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: The $y$-intercept is $2-\log_34$, not 2, so III is false. Answer B.
steps.zh: y 截距是 $2-\log_34$ 而不是 2，故 III 錯誤。答案 B。

traps.en: Reading the constant 2 in $y=2-\log_3(x+4)$ as the $y$-intercept — it is only the vertical shift.
traps.zh: 把 $y=2-\log_3(x+4)$ 中的常數 2 當成 y 截距 —— 它只是圖像的上下平移量。

traps.en: Treating $-\log$ as increasing: a minus sign in front reflects the curve, so it decreases.
traps.zh: 把 $-\log$ 當成增函數：前面的負號會把圖像上下反轉，故為減函數。

tip.en: For $y=c\pm\log_a(x+b)$: the sign of the logarithm decides increasing/decreasing; put $y=0$ for the $x$-intercept and $x=0$ for the $y$-intercept.
tip.zh: 對 $y=c\pm\log_a(x+b)$：對數前的正負決定增減；求 x 截距令 $y=0$，求 y 截距令 $x=0$。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 取對數

steps.en: So $\log y$ is linear in $x$ with vertical intercept $\log a$ and slope $\log b$.
steps.zh: 故 $\log y$ 是 $x$ 的線性函數，縱軸截距為 $\log a$、斜率為 $\log b$。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 讀縱軸截距

steps.en: The graph of $\log y$ against $x$ has vertical intercept 2, and that intercept is $\log a$.
steps.zh: 以 $x$ 為橫軸、$\log y$ 為縱軸的圖，其縱軸截距是 2，而該截距等於 $\log a$。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: Base 10 logarithms (as used in DSE) give $a=100$ — option D.

traps.en: $0.01=10^{-2}$ reverses the sign — the intercept 2 means $\log a=+2$.
Taking $a=10$ (i.e. $\log a=1$) ignores the actual intercept value 2.
traps.zh: 取 $a=10$（即 $\log a=1$）忽略了真正的截距 2。

tip.en: For $y=ab^{x}$, the vertical intercept of the $\log y$ vs $x$ graph is $\log a$ and the slope is $\log b$ — memorise this pair.
tip.zh: 對 $y=ab^{x}$：$\log y$ 對 $x$ 的圖，縱軸截距是 $\log a$、斜率是 $\log b$ —— 這兩點要背熟。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 求 $R$ 的頂點

steps.en: The three boundary lines meet in pairs: $y=7$ with $3x-4y=2$ gives $(10,7)$; $y=7$ with $6x+13y=25$ gives $(-11,7)$; the last two give $(2,1)$. All three satisfy the remaining inequality.

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 逐個頂點求值
答案

steps.en: A linear function on a polygon takes its extreme values at vertices, so the least value is 1 — option A.
steps.zh: 線性函數在多邊形上的極值必在頂點取得，故最小值為 1，選 A。

traps.en: 106 is the **maximum** (at $(10,7)$) — the question asks for the least value.
traps.zh: 106 是**最大值**（在 $(10,7)$ 取得）—— 題目問的是最小值。

traps.en: 42 is the value at $(2,1)$; testing only one vertex misses the true minimum.
traps.zh: 42 是 $(2,1)$ 處的值；只試一個頂點會錯過真正的最小值。

tip.en: Linear programming: sketch the region, list **all** vertices, evaluate the objective at each; the extreme values sit at vertices.
tip.zh: 線性規劃：畫出可行區域，列出**所有**頂點，逐個代入目標函數；極值必在頂點。

title.en: Step 1 · Read the arcs from $AB\parallel TC$
title.zh: 第 1 步 · 由 $AB\parallel TC$ 得弧

steps.en: $AB\parallel TC$ and $T,B,D$ are collinear, so the angle $\angle CTD=23^{\circ}$ equals $\angle ABD$. An inscribed angle is half its arc, so arc $AD=46^{\circ}$.
steps.zh: $AB\parallel TC$ 且 $T,B,D$ 共線，故 $\angle CTD=23^{\circ}$ 等於 $\angle ABD$；圓周角是所對弧的一半，故弧 $AD=46^{\circ}$。

title.en: Step 2 · Use the angle between the chords
title.zh: 第 2 步 · 用弦交角

steps.en: The angle between two chords equals half the sum of the arcs cut off by the angle and its vertical angle; hence arc $BC=124^{\circ}$ (so $\angle CDB=62^{\circ}$).
steps.zh: 兩弦的夾角等於「該角與其對頂角所截兩弧之和」的一半，故弧 $BC=124^{\circ}$（即 $\angle CDB=62^{\circ}$）。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: In $\Delta CTD$, $\angle TDC=180^{\circ}-\angle CDB$ and the angle sum gives $\frac{c}{2}=62^{\circ}-23^{\circ}=39^{\circ}$, so arc $CD=78^{\circ}$. Then arc $AB=360^{\circ}-(46+124+78)^{\circ}=112^{\circ}$, and $\angle ADE=\angle ADB=\frac{112^{\circ}}{2}=56^{\circ}$ — option B.
steps.zh: 在 $\Delta CTD$ 中 $\angle TDC=180^{\circ}-\angle CDB$，由內角和得 $\frac{c}{2}=62^{\circ}-23^{\circ}=39^{\circ}$，故弧 $CD=78^{\circ}$。於是弧 $AB=360^{\circ}-(46+124+78)^{\circ}=112^{\circ}$，$\angle ADE=\angle ADB=\frac{112^{\circ}}{2}=56^{\circ}$，選 B。

traps.en: 39° is only half of arc $CD$ (the angle $\angle TCD$); the question asks for $\angle ADE$, which subtends arc $AB$.
traps.zh: 39° 只是弧 $CD$ 的一半（即 $\angle TCD$）；題目問的 $\angle ADE$ 所對的是弧 $AB$。

traps.en: 62° is $\angle CDB=\frac12$ arc $BC$; do not stop one step early.
traps.zh: 62° 是 $\angle CDB=\frac12$ 弧 $BC$；不要提早一步作答。

tip.en: Turn every given angle into an arc degree ($\times2$ for an inscribed angle, tangent–chord and chord–chord also give half-arcs), then use 'arcs add to $360^{\circ}$'.
tip.zh: 把每個已知角換成弧的度數（圓周角 ×2；切線－弦、弦－弦也都是半弧），再用「三弧之和為 $360^{\circ}$」收尾。

title.en: Step 1 · The four points are concyclic
title.zh: 第 1 步 · 四點共圓

steps.en: Both angles subtend $TU$ and are right angles, so (converse of 'angle in a semicircle') $S,T,U,V$ lie on one circle with $TU$ as diameter.
steps.zh: 兩個角都對着 $TU$ 且都是直角，由「半圓上的圓周角是直角」的逆定理，$S,T,U,V$ 共圓且 $TU$ 為直徑。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · $T$ 處的角

steps.en: In right-angled $\Delta TUV$, $\angle TUV=60^{\circ}$. Opposite angles of the cyclic quadrilateral $STUV$ are supplementary, so $\angle TSV=180^{\circ}-60^{\circ}=120^{\circ}$.
steps.zh: 在直角 $\Delta TUV$ 中 $\angle TUV=60^{\circ}$；圓內接四邊形 $STUV$ 的對角互補，故 $\angle TSV=180^{\circ}-60^{\circ}=120^{\circ}$。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: In $\Delta STV$ ($ST=8$, $SV=5$, included angle $120^{\circ}$) the cosine rule gives $TV=\sqrt{129}$. The sine rule then gives $\sin\angle STV=\frac{5\sin120^{\circ}}{\sqrt{129}}$, so $\angle STV\approx22^{\circ}$. Since $\angle SUV$ and $\angle STV$ stand on the same chord $SV$, $\angle SUV\approx22^{\circ}$ — option A.
steps.zh: 在 $\Delta STV$（$ST=8$、$SV=5$、夾角 $120^{\circ}$）中，用餘弦定理得 $TV=\sqrt{129}$；再用正弦定理得 $\sin\angle STV=\frac{5\sin120^{\circ}}{\sqrt{129}}$，故 $\angle STV\approx22^{\circ}$。因 $\angle SUV$ 與 $\angle STV$ 同對弦 $SV$，得 $\angle SUV\approx22^{\circ}$，選 A。

traps.en: 38° comes from taking $\angle TSV=60^{\circ}$: the quadrilateral is cyclic, so $\angle TSV$ and $\angle TUV$ are supplementary (120°, not 60°).
traps.zh: 38° 來自把 $\angle TSV$ 當成 $60^{\circ}$：四邊形共圓，$\angle TSV$ 與 $\angle TUV$ 互補，應是 $120^{\circ}$。

traps.en: 30° is $\angle UTV$ itself; $\angle SUV$ is not equal to it but to $\angle STV$.
traps.zh: 30° 是 $\angle UTV$ 本身；$\angle SUV$ 不等於它，而是等於 $\angle STV$。

tip.en: Two right angles on the same segment → concyclic (the segment is a diameter); then switch between 'arcs/chords' and the sine and cosine rules to find the required angle.
tip.zh: 同一線段上的兩個直角 → 四點共圓（該線段為直徑）；之後在同弓形角、正弦／餘弦定理之間切換即可求得目標角。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 定出尺寸

steps.en: From $AB:AC:AE=1:1:2$ take $AB=AC=1$, $AE=2$. The right angle at $A$ gives $BC=\sqrt{1^{2}+1^{2}}=\sqrt2$.

title.en: Step 2 · The angle between the two planes
title.zh: 第 2 步 · 線面交角

steps.en: The two planes meet along $BC$. Let $M$ be the midpoint of $BC$: since $AB=AC$, $AM\perp BC$; and as $AE\perp$ the base, $EM\perp BC$ too. So the angle between the planes is $\angle AME$, and $\Delta EAM$ is right-angled at $A$.
steps.zh: 兩平面沿 $BC$ 相交。設 $M$ 為 $BC$ 中點：因 $AB=AC$，$AM\perp BC$；又 $AE\perp$ 底面，故 $EM\perp BC$。因此兩平面的夾角就是 $\angle AME$，而 $\Delta EAM$ 在 $A$ 為直角。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: $EM=\sqrt{4+\frac12}=\frac{3}{\sqrt2}$, so $\cos\theta=\frac13$ and $\sin\theta=\sqrt{1-\frac19}=\frac{2\sqrt2}{3}$ — option D.
steps.zh: $EM=\sqrt{4+\frac12}=\frac{3}{\sqrt2}$，故 $\cos\theta=\frac13$，$\sin\theta=\sqrt{1-\frac19}=\frac{2\sqrt2}{3}$，選 D。

traps.en: $\frac13$ is $\cos\theta$, not $\sin\theta$ — check which ratio the question asks for.
traps.zh: $\frac13$ 是 $\cos\theta$ 而不是 $\sin\theta$ —— 看清楚題目問哪一個比值。

traps.en: Using $AM=AB=\sqrt2$ instead of the median length $\frac{\sqrt2}{2}$ inflates the angle's cosine.
traps.zh: 把 $AM$ 當成 $AB=\sqrt2$（而不是中線長 $\frac{\sqrt2}{2}$），會使餘弦值變大。

tip.en: Angle between two planes: find their line of intersection, then drop perpendiculars from a convenient point to that line in each plane — the angle between those two perpendiculars is the answer.
tip.zh: 兩平面的夾角：先找交線，再在兩個平面內各作交線的垂線 —— 這兩條垂線的夾角就是所求。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 令 $s=\sin^{2}\theta$

steps.en: The equation is quadratic in $\sin^{2}\theta$, so $\sin^{2}\theta=\frac13$ or $\frac12$, i.e. $\sin\theta=\pm\frac{1}{\sqrt3}$ or $\pm\frac{1}{\sqrt2}$.
steps.zh: 方程對 $\sin^{2}\theta$ 是二次式，得 $\sin^{2}\theta=\frac13$ 或 $\frac12$，即 $\sin\theta=\pm\frac{1}{\sqrt3}$ 或 $\pm\frac{1}{\sqrt2}$。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 數 $\frac{1}{\sqrt2}$ 的解

steps.en: Within $90^{\circ}\le\theta\le360^{\circ}$: 45° is too small, so only 135°; the negative value gives both 225° and 315° — 3 roots.
steps.zh: 在 $90^{\circ}\le\theta\le360^{\circ}$ 內：45° 不在範圍內，只有 135°；負值則有 225° 與 315°，共 3 個解。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: $\sin\theta=\frac{1}{\sqrt3}$ gives $35.3^{\circ}$ (rejected) and $144.7^{\circ}$; its negative gives $215.3^{\circ}$ and $324.7^{\circ}$ — another 3 roots. Total $3+3=6$ — option C.
steps.zh: $\sin\theta=\frac{1}{\sqrt3}$ 給出 $35.3^{\circ}$（不合）與 $144.7^{\circ}$；負值給出 $215.3^{\circ}$ 與 $324.7^{\circ}$，又是 3 個解。合共 $3+3=6$，選 C。

traps.en: 4 roots means only $\sin\theta=\pm\frac{1}{\sqrt2}$ was used — the case $\sin^{2}\theta=\frac13$ was dropped.
traps.zh: 4 個解表示只用了 $\sin\theta=\pm\frac{1}{\sqrt2}$，漏掉 $\sin^{2}\theta=\frac13$ 這個情況。

traps.en: 2 roots counts only one angle for each sine value, forgetting that $\sin\theta=k$ has two solutions in a full turn.
traps.zh: 2 個解是每個正弦值只算了一個角，忘了在整圈內 $\sin\theta=k$ 一般有兩個解。

tip.en: For trigonometric equations, list every value $\sin^{2}\theta$ can take, then for each $\pm$ value sketch the sine curve and count the solutions inside the given interval.
tip.zh: 三角方程：先列出 $\sin^{2}\theta$ 的所有可能值，再對每個 $\pm$ 值畫正弦圖形，數出在指定區間內的解。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 總數

steps.en: Choose any 5 of the 10 students.
steps.zh: 從 10 名學生中任選 5 名。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 數「至多 2 名男生」

steps.en: Split into 0, 1 and 2 boys; the girls fill the rest.
steps.zh: 分成 0、1、2 名男生三種情況，其餘由女生補足。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: (Or take the complement: $1-\frac{\binom33\binom72}{252}=1-\frac{21}{252}=\frac{11}{12}$.) Option B.

traps.en: $\frac{119}{120}$ comes from using $1-\frac{1}{120}$ as if only one committee had 3 boys; actually $\binom33\binom72=21$ do.
traps.zh: $\frac{119}{120}$ 來自把「3 名男生」的組合當成只有 1 個；實際上有 $\binom33\binom72=21$ 個。

traps.en: $\frac{251}{252}$ subtracts a single case out of 252, again underestimating the complement.
traps.zh: $\frac{251}{252}$ 只從 252 中扣掉 1 個情況，同樣低估了反面事件。

tip.en: For 'at most / at least' questions, either split into cases or use the complement — whichever has fewer cases; both must be counted with combinations, not permutations.
tip.zh: 「至多／至少」的題目：分情況或取反面，選情況較少的一邊；兩者都要用組合數而不是排列數。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 誰被排除？

steps.en: Choosing 7 from 8 employees means leaving one out, and the two types of employee give two different cases.
steps.zh: 從 8 人中選 7 人，等於排除 1 人；全職與兼職被排除時情況不同，要分開討論。

title.en: Step 2 · Case 1 — a full-timer is left out
title.zh: 第 2 步 · 情況一：排除全職

steps.en: Leaving out one of the 5 full-timers gives 4 full-time and 3 part-time. Arrange the 4 full-timers ($4!$), then put the 3 part-timers into 3 of the 5 gaps around/between them ($\binom53$) and order them ($3!$).
steps.zh: 排除 5 名全職之一，得 4 全職、3 兼職。先排 4 名全職（$4!$），再把 3 名兼職放入 5 個空隙中的 3 個（$\binom53$）並排列（$3!$）。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: Case 2: leaving out one of the 3 part-timers gives 5 full-time and 2 part-time, so $5!\times\binom62\times2!=3600$ each. Total $10800+7200=18000$ — option C.
steps.zh: 情況二：排除 3 名兼職之一，得 5 全職、2 兼職，每種 $5!\times\binom62\times2!=3600$。合計 $10800+7200=18000$，選 C。

traps.en: 5040 is just $7!$ — it ignores the 'no two part-timers adjacent' condition completely.
traps.zh: 5040 就是 $7!$，完全忽略了「兼職不相鄰」的條件。

traps.en: 14400 counts only one of the two cases (it forgets the queues where a part-timer is left out).
traps.zh: 14400 只算了兩種情況中的一種（漏掉排除兼職的排法）。

tip.en: For 'no two alike are adjacent', arrange the other group first, then place the restricted ones in the gaps; remember to check whether the selection itself has cases.
tip.zh: 「同類不相鄰」：先排另一類，再把受限制的放進空隙；別忘了先確認「選人」本身有幾種情況。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 標準分公式

steps.en: The score equals the mean plus the standard score times the standard deviation.
steps.zh: 分數等於平均數加上「標準分 × 標準差」。

title.en: Step 2 · Find $\sigma$ from the two known scores
title.zh: 第 2 步 · 由兩個已知分數求 $\sigma$

steps.en: Subtracting removes $\mu$: the difference in scores equals the difference in standard scores times $\sigma$.
steps.zh: 相減可消去 $\mu$：分數之差＝標準分之差 × $\sigma$。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: Again the mean cancels, so no need to find it — option B.
steps.zh: 同樣消去平均數，不必求出它，得 36，選 B。

traps.en: 31 is $\alpha$ alone: $\alpha=40-1\times9=31$; the question asks for $\beta-\alpha$.
traps.zh: 31 只是 $\alpha$ 本身：$\alpha=40-1\times9=31$；題目問的是 $\beta-\alpha$。

traps.en: 98 is $\alpha+\beta=31+67$; adding instead of subtracting the two scores.
traps.zh: 98 是 $\alpha+\beta=31+67$，把兩個分數相加而不是相減。

tip.en: With standard scores, differences cancel the mean: score difference $=$ standard-score difference $\times\sigma$. Use this whenever the question asks for a difference.
tip.zh: 標準分的題目：相減可消去平均數 —— 分數差＝標準分差 × 標準差。問「差」時優先用這條。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 做了甚麼變換？

steps.en: Each new number is the old one multiplied by $\frac15$ and then increased by $\frac25$.
steps.zh: 每個新數是原數乘 $\frac15$ 再加 $\frac25$。

title.en: Step 2 · Effect on the standard deviation
title.zh: 第 2 步 · 對標準差的影響

steps.en: Adding a constant shifts every value equally, so the spread is unchanged; multiplying by $\frac15$ shrinks the standard deviation by the same factor.
steps.zh: 加常數只是整體平移，分佈的分散程度不變；乘 $\frac15$ 則把標準差按同一倍數縮小。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: The variance is the square of the standard deviation — option A.
steps.zh: 變異數是標準差的平方，得 1，選 A。

traps.en: 25 is the original variance: forgetting that dividing the data by 5 also divides the spread by 5.
traps.zh: 25 是原變異數：忘了數據除以 5 時，分散程度也除以 5。

traps.en: 5 is the original standard deviation; the question asks for the **variance** of the new data.
traps.zh: 5 是原本的標準差；題目問的是新數據的**變異數**。

tip.en: Transformations: adding/subtracting a constant changes the mean only; multiplying/dividing changes the mean and scales the standard deviation by the same factor, the variance by its square.
tip.zh: 變換性質：加／減常數只影響平均數；乘／除則同時影響平均數，並把標準差按同倍數、變異數按平方縮放。

title.zh: 第 1 步 · 作輔助線

steps.en: $\angle EAB=\angle ABC=90^{\circ}$, both taken with $AB$, so $EA\parallel BC$. Draw through the inner vertex $D$ a straight line $\ell$ parallel to $BC$ — it is then also parallel to $EA$.
steps.zh: $\angle EAB$ 與 $\angle ABC$ 同與 $AB$ 成直角，故 $EA\parallel BC$。過內凹頂點 $D$ 作直線 $\ell$ 平行於 $BC$，它同時平行於 $EA$。

title.zh: 第 2 步 · 把 $D$ 處的角切開

steps.en: The line $\ell$ passes through $D$ and lies between $DC$ and $DE$, so the angle $q$ is the sum of the two parts it makes.
steps.zh: 直線 $\ell$ 過 $D$ 且落在 $DC$ 與 $DE$ 之間，故角 $q$ 等於它所切出的兩部分之和。

title.zh: 第 3 步 · 內錯角給出 $p$ 與 $r$

steps.en: $EA\parallel\ell$ with transversal $ED$: the alternate angles are equal, so the angle between $\ell$ and $DE$ equals $p$ at $E$. Likewise $BC\parallel\ell$ with transversal $CD$ gives $\angle(CD,\ell)=r$.
steps.zh: $EA\parallel\ell$、$ED$ 為截線：內錯角相等，故 $\ell$ 與 $DE$ 的夾角等於 $E$ 處的 $p$。同理 $BC\parallel\ell$、$CD$ 為截線，得 $\angle(CD,\ell)=r$。

title.zh: 答案

steps.en: Adding the two parts gives $q=p+r$ — option C. (Check with the pentagon angle sum: $90^{\circ}+90^{\circ}+r+(360^{\circ}-q)+p=540^{\circ}$ gives the same relation.)
steps.zh: 兩部分相加得 $q=p+r$，選 C。（也可用五邊形內角和驗證：$90^{\circ}+90^{\circ}+r+(360^{\circ}-q)+p=540^{\circ}$，得同一關係。）

traps.en: $p=r$ only holds in the special case where the figure is symmetric (e.g. when $D$ is directly below the midpoint of $BC$); moving $D$ changes $p$ and $r$ independently.
traps.zh: $p=r$ 只在圖形對稱的特例成立（例如 $D$ 正好在 $BC$ 中點的正下方）；移動 $D$ 時 $p$ 與 $r$ 各自改變。

traps.en: With $q=p+r$, the sum $p+q+r=2q$, which equals $180^{\circ}$ only when $q=90^{\circ}$ — that is option B, and it is not forced.
traps.zh: 由 $q=p+r$ 得 $p+q+r=2q$，只有當 $q=90^{\circ}$ 時才等於 $180^{\circ}$（即選項 B），而 $q$ 不必然為直角。

tip.en: When a broken line joins two parallel lines, draw a parallel line through the turning point: alternate angles then turn the whole problem into one addition. Never guess equal angles from the picture.
tip.zh: 折線夾在兩條平行線之間時，過轉折點作平行線：內錯角會把問題化為一條加法。不要憑圖猜「看起來相等」的角。
